q1.explanationZh: 第二段说 Downey 去厨房找了些花生，再回到阳台，就是为了给松鼠找吃的。

evidence.quote: Downey found some peanuts in his kitchen and hurried back to the balcony.

q2.explanationZh: 后面说这次相遇“让他高兴起来”（cheered him up），所以之前他心情不好，down 就是 sad。

evidence.quote: Downey had been feeling down, and this special meeting cheered him up.

q3.explanationZh: 文中说其中一只松鼠有时会带来它的朋友，Downey 把这一对叫作 Richard 和 Maxine，所以它们是朋友。

evidence.quote: Sometimes, he brings his friend. Downey named the pair Richard and Maxine.

q4.explanationZh: 第三段说视频很快走红（went viral），说明它非常受欢迎。有人叫他“松鼠爸爸”，但没有人给他取名叫“白雪公主”，只是拿他和白雪公主比。

q5.explanationZh: Downey 对松鼠说：生活不如意时，不要给自己太大压力。意思就是遇到不顺的事要保持冷静。

evidence.quote: “When life is down, don’t put too much pressure on yourself.”

q6.explanationZh: 最后一段说 Downey 还为松鼠们造了一座房子。

evidence.quote: Downey has also built a house for the squirrels.
